verdict.rationale: Alloy is an identity, fraud and compliance SaaS platform, so an official CLI is a fair axis to ask about. However, the evidence pack documents only APIs, webhooks, an SDK and llms.txt docs, and never mentions a command-line tool. The SDK and APIs are developer building blocks, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
